messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend periods** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, creating a three‑day weekend; if the holiday falls on a Saturday or Tuesday, the adjacent weekend days are also included.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Period | Notes |
|---------|-------------|---------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday, Jan 1 | **Dec 30–Jan 2, 2022–2023** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| Family Day (AB, SK, MB, NB) | Friday, Feb 20 | **Feb 18–20** | Observed in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick. |
| Family Day (ON) | Friday, Feb 27 | **Feb 25–27** | Observed in Ontario. |
| Good Friday | Friday, Apr 7 | **Apr 7–9** | Observed in most provinces. |
| Victoria Day | Monday, May 22 | **May 20–22** | National holiday. |
| Canada Day | Saturday, Jul 1 | **Jul 1–3** | Creates a 4‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| Labour Day | Monday, Sep 4 | **Sep 2–4** | National holiday. |
| Thanksgiving | Monday, Oct 9 | **Oct 7–9** | National holiday. |
| Remembrance Day | Friday, Nov 11 | **Nov 11–13** | Observed in most provinces. |
| Christmas Day | Monday, Dec 25 | **Dec 23–25** | National holiday. |
| Boxing Day | Tuesday, Dec 26 | **Dec 26–28** | Observed in some provinces; creates a 3‑day weekend (Tue‑Wed‑Thu). |

> **Pro‑Tip:** If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, you might want to allow users to filter by province, since some holidays (e.g., Family Day, Boxing Day) are province‑specific. The above table lists the *national* holidays that create long weekends across Canada in 2023.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full list of statutory holidays for each province or any other details!
